text: No tengo nada que ver con ella.
reason: Nada que ver expresses absence of a connection, not obligation.

text: Ella tiene dos años más que tú.
reason: Compares her age with yours.

text: Será mejor que consultes a tu médico.
reason: Que introduces the recommended action; there is no than-comparison.

text: A ti te gusta la música.
reason: Direction, time, addressee or relational complement, not a direct-object personal a.

text: No puedo responder a esta pregunta.
reason: Governed complement of responder.

text: Ven a ver esto chicos.
reason: Direction, time, addressee or relational complement, not a direct-object personal a.

text: ¿Quién dice que no nos vamos a ver de nuevo?
reason: Ir a plus infinitive expresses a future/intended action.

text: ¿Es lo único que vas a decir?
reason: Neuter lo nominalises an adjective: único, peor, mejor.

text: Él es conocido por eso.
reason: Preposition introduces benefit, cause, purpose or action still to be done.

text: ¿Y qué sabe tu corazón sobre mí?
reason: Interrogative asks for a thing or action, directly or embedded.

text: ¿Qué tienes en la boca?
reason: Interrogative asks for a thing or action, directly or embedded.

text: No sé qué va a pasar.
reason: Interrogative asks for a thing or action, directly or embedded.

text: Me comí uno de esos y fue terrible.
reason: Me in comí is an aspectual pronominal marker, not myself as food.

text: Me gustaría volver al trabajo.
reason: Contraction a + el introduces a destination/exposure.

text: Ella se arrodilló al entrar a la iglesia.
reason: Al plus infinitive introduces the time of entering.

text: ¡12.000 $ al año es una fortuna en Polonia!
reason: Contracted preposition in a rate expression.

text: ¿De dónde se conocen el uno al otro?
reason: Explicit el uno al otro makes this reciprocal.

text: Eres el único al que se lo he contado.
reason: Se replaces le before lo; indirect object, not reflexive.

text: El médico dice que se pondrá bien.
reason: Ponerse bien expresses recovery/change of state.

text: - ¿Se ahorcó a sí misma?
reason: A sí misma explicitly identifies a reflexive object.

text: El inglés también se estudia en China.
meaning: is studied / was taught / has been fixed
reason: Patient subject with passive se, not an unspecified actor as grammatical subject.

text: La fecha y el lugar de nuestro próximo concierto todavía no se ha fijado.
meaning: is studied / was taught / has been fixed
reason: Patient subject with passive se, not an unspecified actor as grammatical subject.

text: Não digas que não, porque eu ouvi-a.
reason: Attached object clitic in ouvi-a, not an article.

text: Lembrem-se de que se têm um ao outro.
reason: First se is attached to lembrem; second is reciprocal têm um ao outro.

text: Não se esqueça de assinar o cheque.
reason: Pronominal esquecer-se de is forget.

text: Suspeita-se que ela seja uma espiã.
reason: Unspecified human actor with no patient subject: cheating, suspecting a clause.

text: Eu me arrependo muito disso.
reason: Pronominal arrepender-se expresses regret.

text: Eu tenho que me preparar para a prova de inglês.
reason: Speaker prepares himself/herself for a test.

text: - Ele disse-me para trazer isto.
reason: Recipient/addressee/beneficiary clitic; first occurrence reviewed.

text: É uma das vantagens do trabalho.
reason: Partitive uma das vantagens means one of the benefits.

text: E esperei muito por isto.
reason: Por introduces the thing/person waited for; isto is an object, not therefore.

text: Com licença, podemos nos sentar aqui?
reason: Speakers seat themselves.

text: Ajudemo-nos uns aos outros!
reason: Nos refers to the participants acting toward each other; uns aos outros is explicit in row 6865.

text: Eu tenho cada vez menos tempo para ler.
reason: Gradual decreasing change; label must retain the cada vez construction.

text: Nosso mundo está ficando cada vez menor.
reason: Gradual decreasing change; label must retain the cada vez construction.
